name: Memento Solis
source:
In a story inspired by the lore surrounding Octavio's Poppets, players will explore a run-down hospital to retrieve something taken from Octavio by a mysterious doctor with a vendetta - and perhaps uncover things best left forgotten along the way.

[From [url=https://octavios-concert-hall.itch.io/memento-solis]itch.io[/url]]
